events.text:
## Recommendation
- **Expect below-average pier fishing this week at all four ports: 1 of 4 at St. Joseph, South Haven, Grand Haven and Muskegon.** Muskegon is the least certain, since it has no 2024 pier report.
- **Go to Grand Haven** if you're choosing one. It's a near tie with South Haven, but its latest pier report is the only one that names a working method.
- **Fish casting spoons or body baits, not spawn,** at Grand Haven, as the latest report suggests.
- **Check that the pier is open before you drive.** South Haven's latest report only mentions catches "when the piers were open."

## Why
- Pier reports at all four ports have been slow to below average for weeks, so I'd expect this week to be similar (Grand Haven 2024-04-24, South Haven 2024-04-24, St. Joseph 2024-04-24).
- The Grand Haven pier anglers did better on casting spoons or body baits than on spawn, which is the only specific method guidance from the pier reports (Grand Haven, 2024-04-24).
- The buoy water is warming, not dropping, so I see no upwelling signal that would pull fish to the piers (buoy readings for the week before 2024-04-30).

## Evidence
**Recent reports (last 4 weeks, salmon)**
- Grand Haven, 2024-04-24, pier: "Pier anglers caught a few coho salmon and brown trout when casting body baits or spoons... casting spoons or body baits seemed to be more productive than using spawn." Quality 1.
- South Haven, 2024-04-24, pier: "When the piers were open, a few steelhead and coho salmon were caught using spawn." Quality 1. South Haven's pier was also rated 1 on 2024-04-17 and 2024-04-03.
- St. Joseph, 2024-04-24, pier: "Pier fishing was on the slow side for all species, but anglers did catch a few coho salmon and steelhead." Quality 1. The 2024-04-17 pier report was quality 0 ("fishing was slow").
- Grand Haven, 2024-04-10, pier: a few coho and brown trout on spawn, quality 1.
- Muskegon: the 2024 reports cover boats only. The most recent boat report (2024-04-17) rated fishing 1 and said the best action was "from the shoreline out to 60 feet of water," with bright spoons working.
- Boats are doing better than the piers. Grand Haven's 2024-04-24 boat reports cite 25–50 feet of water, and the 2024-04-10 Grand Haven boat report rated fishing 3 for trolling spoons out to 50 feet.

**Past seasons (similar water temperature, roughly late April to May)**
- Matching weeks from earlier years, with surface water within 4 F of today's, show pier fishing staying slow: Muskegon, 2023-04-26, pier quality 0 ("very slow"), and South Haven, 2023-04-26, pier quality 0. Pier fishing was also slow at Grand Haven (2023-05-10) and South Haven (2023-05-17) in the same stretch, even though those weeks had sharp water drops.
- The best past results came from boats in deeper water, such as St. Joseph (2023-05-10, quality 3, 80 feet) and South Haven (2023-05-17, quality 3, 80 feet).

**Conditions now**
- Measured buoy surface water for the week before 2024-04-30: St. Joseph and South Haven averaged 48 F, and Grand Haven and Muskegon averaged 47 F. All four rose about 3 F over the week.
- The tool returned no modeled pierhead water, no cold-layer depth, and no wind forecast, so I can't say what the piers' water is doing right now.

## Caveats
- The newest report is from 2024-04-24, six days old. The conditions tool returned a backtest summary for the week before 2024-04-30, not live data, so treat the water readings as a guide.
- The reports are spring reports, which show pier action is slow in April. Summer and fall can differ a lot, and the reference notes that the lake may not yet be stratified, so depth matters less right now.
- Muskegon's rating is a low-confidence estimate, because it has no 2024 pier report and its last pier report (2023-04-26) was quality 0.
- Reference guidance (NY DEC, Michigan Sea Grant): salmon prefer 52–58 F water, and upwellings, marked by a sharp drop in buoy temperature, are what bring fish toward piers. Neither applies directly to this week's data.

## Sources
- Grand Haven, South Haven, St. Joseph, 2024-04-24: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3987c22
- South Haven, St. Joseph, Muskegon, 2024-04-17: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/39703c8
- Grand Haven, Muskegon, 2024-04-10: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/39595be
- South Haven, St. Joseph, 2024-04-03: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/39420c4
- Past seasons: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3573537 (2023-04-26), https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/359cab8 (2023-05-10), https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/35b2589 (2023-05-17)
